svg.title: Pin-1 and polarity marks done well and badly
svg.desc: Drawn to scale. Top left: an 8-pin IC footprint with a rectangular pin-1 pad, rounded other pads and a silkscreen dot right beside pin 1, outside the part's outline, so it stays visible after placement. Top right: the same footprint with all pads alike and the dot inside the outline, hidden once the part is placed. Bottom left: two 0603 LEDs on the recommended 0603 footprint, one marked with the letter K beside the cathode pad, the other with a short bar beside the cathode pad, about as long as the pad is wide. Bottom right: the same footprint with the cathode bar under the part, hidden once the part is placed. Marks under a part are lost as soon as it is placed.
